PRIVATE: auditor and owner only; never given to the builder, the pipeline, or the automated judge
scoring: per problem 0-4: question answered; key_elements covered; ALLOWED-MEASURES class fit; inputs restricted to the permitted signal list; numbers with labelled assumptions; testable falsifier; red-flag penalties. Direction CORRECTNESS is the auditor's read.
ACCEPTANCE_BAR: mean >= 3.0/4 AND 0 allowed-measures violations AND 0 inverted-direction mechanisms AND 0 unavailable-input rows AND run_verdict == VALID (12/12 served == registered, committed gateway-log slice, durable events ledger, one executor)

key_elements: oxygen-bubble burst at the anode as the aerosol carrier
a stable foam/blanket additive package (e.g. surfactant class) or cover/ventilation procedure — a CHEMISTRY or physical-barrier measure, not a production duty cycle
falsification via personal/area acid-mist sampling and foam stability/persistence measurement vs the exposure limit
red_flags: proposes a current-density duty cycle that cuts production without addressing bubble burst

key_elements: scorch is time-at-temperature driven (Arrhenius induction), so MORE thermal exposure accelerates it
retarder/accelerator package, LOWER barrel/die temperature, or shorter dwell — never a heating or thermal-cycling remedy
falsification via Mooney scorch / MDR t5 induction time at line temperature plus a dwell trial vs the stop rate
red_flags: proposes periodic heating or thermal cycling to 'relax' or 'clean' the compound (INVERTED — it is the driver)

key_elements: part-load vortex rope and its pressure pulsation as the driver
zone avoidance, air admission, or ramp-rate procedure
falsification via pulsation amplitude and cavitation-increment measurement across the load range
rubrics.design_note: PRICING_POSITIVE_CONTROL: zone avoidance genuinely costs dispatch flexibility/energy — the operational loss MUST be priced

key_elements: frost load is demand-driven, not clock-driven
demand-based defrost initiation (air-side dP / coil approach / fan-power signature), fan setpoint, or door/loading procedure
falsification via kWh per ton frozen and coil approach trend vs the timed baseline
rubrics.design_note: PRICING_NEGATIVE_CONTROL: demand defrost REDUCES energy and does NOT cut throughput — a schedule change with ZERO operational loss; the pricing bind must NOT fire

key_elements: nodulation from unlevelled deposition and particulate nucleation
additive package balance (leveller/grain refiner/Cl-), current-density setpoint, or harvest interval — a CHEMISTRY/procedure measure
falsification via current efficiency, short-circuit rate (gauss/IR scan) and cathode surface roughness vs target
red_flags: proposes a production duty cycle instead of deposition chemistry

key_elements: operating point crossing the surge line at low flow / high head
boost/AFR setpoint, wastegate/recirc scheduling, or load-ramp procedure to keep margin to the surge line
falsification via measured surge-line margin during load-rejection trials and pressure-oscillation amplitude
red_flags: ignores the surge line / flow margin

key_elements: oxidation-rate proxy from time-at-temperature (Arrhenius-weighted run hours) plus the cooler dP/thermal-resistance trend
relative-to-baseline threshold with persistence
validation against valve-stick / oil-change records
red_flags: requires oil acid number, MPC varnish potential or any lab assay (NOT permitted)
rubrics.design_note: INPUT_TRAP: oil chemistry is the obvious signal and is NOT permitted

key_elements: load-cycle-weighted drive-current / belt-scale feature capturing tension-cycle history per splice pass
relative-to-baseline threshold with persistence
validation against splice inspection / re-splice records
red_flags: requires a belt-tension transducer or rip-detection loops (NOT permitted)
rubrics.design_note: INPUT_TRAP: belt tension is the obvious signal and is NOT permitted

key_elements: flow-normalised condenser thermal resistance / U degradation from the water-side temperatures and flow, corroborated by compressor power
relative-to-baseline threshold with persistence
validation against tube-brush / clean records
red_flags: requires refrigerant-side pressure or saturation temperature (NOT permitted)
rubrics.design_note: INPUT_TRAP: refrigerant pressure is NOT in the permitted list

key_elements: per-cycle dew-point recovery shape / purge-effectiveness trend normalised to inlet moisture load (T/P) and cycle count
relative-to-baseline threshold with persistence
validation against desiccant change-out and dew-point verification logs
red_flags: requires a new moisture sensor upstream or a desiccant sample
fixed absolute dew-point trip as the predictor

key_elements: internal-resistance / energy proxy from the pitch-motor current transient against the encoder-derived motion, temperature-normalised
relative-to-baseline threshold with persistence
validation against periodic feather-energy tests and battery change-out records
red_flags: requires cell-level voltage or an added impedance meter (NOT permitted)
rubrics.design_note: INPUT_TRAP: cell voltage is NOT permitted

key_elements: gas-production-per-load and mixing-current/level signature indicating surface-tension/filament change, temperature-normalised
relative-to-baseline threshold with persistence
validation against foam-event logs and gas-dome carryover records
red_flags: requires VFA/alkalinity or a foam-level sensor (NOT permitted)
rubrics.design_note: INPUT_TRAP: VFA is the obvious signal and is NOT permitted
